author: reek
body: The opt-in cost-based inliner (`passes=+inline-cost-based`, via the `.flags` sidecar) over the exact shape that found its template-reuse defect. `make-pbox` is a record-building candidate with two call sites; `subst-once`'s record arm used to `__record-set` the candidate's body template in place, so the first site's argument replaced the field value for every later site, splicing the first caller's locals into a function that does not bind them (CDX2040 `Unresolved call` at emit, or silently the wrong record). The assertion that matters is the SECOND caller's record carrying the SECOND caller's values. `pick2` rides along as the branchy arithmetic shape the leaf pass refuses (it has an `if`) and the cost pass takes.
